title: Cartesian cosheaves Cosh^cart_G(X,R,φ) and unit isomorphism
body_html:
Cartesian cosheaves $\Cosh^{\mathrm{cart}}_G(X, R, \phi)$

Following [Lanard] and [DF]:

Definition. $\Cosh^{\mathrm{cart}}_G(X, R, \phi) \subseteq \Cosh_G(X, R, \phi)$ is the full subcategory of those $\mathscr{V}$ such that the restriction $r^\mathscr{V}_{F, E}$ induces a bijection between $\mathscr{V}_F$ and $\mathscr{V}_E[\phi_F]$ for all $F \prec E$.

The image of $\Loc_\phi$ lies in $\Cosh^{\mathrm{cart}}_G(X, R, \phi)$.

Proposition. Assume (T1)–(T5). For $\mathscr{V} \in \Cosh^{\mathrm{cart}}_G(X, R, \phi)$, $$\mathrm{unit}_\mathscr{V} : \mathscr{V} \to \Loc_\phi(H_0(\mathscr{V}))$$ is an isomorphism.

In the paper: the proof block in Sheaf7.tex §7.2 is currently empty.

In the blueprint: a self-contained proof has been fully written, split into six supporting nodes. All technical steps are spelled out; the only remaining work is LaTeX transcription.

Proof outline (blueprint version)

The proof follows Proof plan: Cartesian unit-iso via apartment-level system of idempotents:

Step Node Status
1 — Reduction to apartment Reduction lemma: cartesian unit-iso check transfers to apartment ✅ fully proved
2 — Idempotent system from (T1)–(T5) [[node:coefficient_systems.idempotent_system_from_T_axioms]] ✅ fully proved (5 properties)
3 — Local maps along taut paths Local maps ε^τ_σ along taut paths in the apartment ✅ defined
4 — Well-definedness of $\varepsilon^\tau_\sigma$ (same node) ✅ fully proved (2 case-analysis cases)
5a — Lanard 4.9 analogue $i_\mathcal F \varepsilon^\mathcal E_\mathcal F = e_\mathcal F i_\mathcal E$ Lanard 4.9 analogue: i_F ∘ ε^E_F = e_F ∘ i_E for adjacent facets ✅ fully proved + iteration corollary
5b/c/d — Unit-iso assembly (injectivity, apartment surjectivity, $K_x$-extension) Unit-iso assembly: V_F ≅ e_F H_0 via surjectivity + injectivity ✅ fully proved

Companion theorem (the categorical equivalence)

The proposition above upgrades directly to the cartesian equivalence, with both unit and counit isomorphisms following from the unit-iso theorem applied at $\sV$ and at $\Loc_\phi V$ respectively (via the adjunction triangle identity, see Unit-iso assembly: V_F ≅ e_F H_0 via surjectivity + injectivity):

Theorem (cartesian equivalence). Under (T1)–(T5), $$\Loc_\phi : \Rep_\Phi(G) \;\xrightleftarrows[\sim]{\sim}\; \Cosh^{\mathrm{cart}}_G(\BSigma, R, \phi) : H_0 \circ C_\bullet$$ is an equivalence of categories. The Serre-subcategory property (S) for $\Rep_\Phi(G)$ is now a consequence (Serre-subcategory property (S) — a consequence, not a hypothesis) rather than a hypothesis.

This is the same theorem as [Lan19 Thm 4.10/4.11] and [DF Prop 3.2.4], specialized to our $(\Phi, \BSigma)$ setting and proved from scratch (not citing them as a black box, per user decision).
